name: Las Vegas Howlfest
description:
Las Vegas Fur Con (LVFC) has been held at the Alexis Park Resort since 2023, with the open, greenspace-oriented property granting LVFC a unique vibe. Since inception, several LVFC attendees have called for the con to happen twice a year; it was from this idea that Las Vegas Howlfest was born! Howlfest is a second convention offering more of what makes so many furs love LVFC – 21+ admission, a full buyout of our hotel (every room is a furry!), an open block party for attendees, a location just off the Strip in fabulous Las Vegas…

… but now with a Halloween twist! The first Howlfest will be held October 21-24, 2027 at the Alexis Park Resort in Las Vegas, Nevada. Join us for a howling (and maybe haunted) good time in our furry village!
